notes: Direct fetch worked throughout (no blocking). Site is Shopify + an Algolia-Shopify search/collection integration; app_id, search-only api key and index name (shopify_products, index_prefix 'shopify_') were read straight out of the collection page's embedded config. Qty for every leaf = Algolia query {facetFilters:['collections:<handle>'], distinct:1} nbHits, the exact same endpoint/params the storefront's own collection grid calls. Verified: (a) returned hit count always equals nbHits in a single unpaginated request (no truncation), (b) enumerated hits and counted unique product 'id' values on 5 categories (chandeliers 216/217, sconces 370/376, wall-mirrors 106/106, vases 218/231, table-lamps 323/325, painting 297/300) -- small gaps trace to the index's own distinct_key differing from the raw 'id' field, not to double counting; nbHits is the authoritative distinct total the site itself renders on. Rule 0 gain: kept Bathroom Wall Lighting, Bathroom Ceiling Lighting, Outdoor Wall Lighting, Outdoor Ceiling Lighting (room-named lighting nodes) and Bathroom Mirrors + Medicine Cabinets (bathroom-named mirror node, product_type on-site is literally 'Wall Decor + Mirrors') instead of dropping them for containing Bathroom/Outdoor in the name. Dual-nav overlaps documented, not double counted: Bathroom Wall/Ceiling Lighting also appear under the Outdoor tab as Outdoor Wall/Ceiling Lighting siblings (different handles, different populations, both kept); Bathroom Lighting and Bathroom Mirrors + Medicine Cabinets also appear a second time under the Bed + Bath tab pointing at the identical URLs already captured under Lighting/Walls -- not re-emitted. All Mirrors (parent, /collections/mirrors) nbHits=178 = Wall Mirrors(106)+Full Length Mirrors(72) exactly, confirming it is a pure union rollup, so only the two children are leaves. Excluded as mixed roll-ups after inspecting product titles: Outdoor Decor + Patio Umbrellas/Decor + Planters (/collections/outdoor-decor, 56) -- majority-variant share is Patio Umbrellas + Umbrella Bases (furniture), remainder overlaps the already-counted Pots + Planters and Decorative Objects children; Bath Accessories + Organization (/collections/bath-accessories, 54) -- mix of textile Bath Mats (Bed & Bath product_type) and decorative bath accessories with no URL to split them; Fireplace Screens + Accessories (/collections/fireplace-accessories, 7) -- fireplace screens and tool sets are functional/safety equipment, not decor; Wall Art Sets (/collections/wall-art-sets, 79) -- a 'sold as set' facet re-cut of Paintings/Vintage/Modern/Textile Wall Art, not a distinct type. Also excluded per standing rules: Ceiling Fans, Light Bulbs + Accessories, Candles + Home Fragrance, Wreaths + Garlands, Wall Shelving + Cabinets (furniture/storage), Table Linens + Coasters and Curtains + Shades and Fabric by the Yard (textiles), Flatware, all Wallpaper variants, all Bed/Bath textiles and fixtures/faucets, Kitchen Accessories + Organization and Storage + Organization (pantry/storage), all Furniture and Rugs and Pillows + Throws branches, all designer/brand collaboration collections (Sarah Sherman Samuel, Ginny Macdonald, Heidi Caillier, Rylee + Cru, Huey Lightshop, etc.), and all New/Bestsellers/Sale/Collections marketing pages. Curtain Rods + Hardware (4) kept per the explicit brief carve-out for curtain rods/hardware.
